categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in intelligent logistics systems, providing comprehensive solutions for conveying, sorting, and warehousing. Its main product lines include integrated sorting systems, cross-belt sorting systems, large parcel sorting systems, narrow-band sorting machines, intelligent warehousing systems, dynamic weighing equipment, single-item separation systems, and conveying equipment. It also develops and produces core components such as cameras, sorting carts, dynamic weighing devices, and electric rollers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including industrial IoT high-performance edge computing, machine vision-based barcode/QR code recognition, deep learning for visual positioning and object detection, 3D dynamic and static volume measurement, servo motor integrated drive control, wireless power supply, modular distributed electrical control systems, remote fault diagnosis, and integrated warehouse and distribution technologies. Production follows a customized 'make-to-order' model with integrated software and hardware design, component manufacturing, and on-site installation and commissioning.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic express delivery and logistics companies such as ZTO Express, SF Express, J&T Express, China Post, JD.com, STO Express, Yunda, and Deppon. The company serves industries including express logistics, e-commerce, civil aviation airports, industrial manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, food, home furnishing, and new energy sectors. It has expanded its customer base internationally across Asia, America, Europe, and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Wuxi, China, with manufacturing bases in Anhui and Jiangxi provinces, and R&D centers in Jiangsu and Zhejiang. It has established subsidiaries and branches in Singapore, the United States, Malaysia, Hungary, Mexico, Russia, Thailand, Germany, the United Kingdom, Brazil, and South Korea, supporting global sales and localized services.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream system integrator and manufacturer within the intelligent logistics equipment supply chain. It develops and produces core components and integrates them into comprehensive intelligent logistics solutions, covering upstream component manufacturing and downstream system integration and deployment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on the 'one body, two wings' framework: intelligent logistics equipment as the core, with industrial sensors (machine vision) and power technology (servo, drive, electric rollers) as wings. R&D priorities include enhancing sorting efficiency, accuracy, and cost reduction through proprietary technologies, expanding product series, and deepening vertical integration. The company invests heavily in AI, machine vision, robotics, and intelligent warehousing technologies, aiming to lead in global intelligent logistics and smart manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through customized product sales of intelligent logistics systems and components, project-based system integration contracts, and after-sales services including installation, maintenance, and software upgrades. The company also earns income from leasing equipment and providing technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic intelligent logistics system integrator and equipment manufacturer, ranking among the top tier in China's express logistics intelligent equipment market. It competes with both domestic and international players by offering integrated solutions with proprietary core technologies and comprehensive product lines. It holds a strong market position with recognized technology leadership and extensive customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.96 billion, a 15.44% decrease from the previous year, but achieved a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 20.85 million, reversing prior losses. The gross margin improved to 22.25%. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets of RMB 6.7 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.65 billion. It continues to invest significantly in R&D, with expenditures accounting for 8.57% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive intelligent logistics solutions integrating core hardware and software developed in-house, including advanced machine vision, AI algorithms, and proprietary servo and drive technologies. Its modular and scalable product design reduces customization complexity and installation time, enhancing system reliability and cost-effectiveness. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and global operational network provide differentiated value to customers seeking high-efficiency, accurate, and flexible intelligent logistics systems.
